Board of Education Annual Calendar of Meetings

February 2026 - January 2027

The schedule of meetings listed below is for February 2026 through, to, and including January 2027.  The Board of Education meetings are scheduled to be held in the Town Council Chambers,
45 South Main Street unless otherwise noted. 

The Instructional and Operations Committee meetings begin at 6:00 p.m. unless otherwise noted by the agenda.

The Board of Education Meetings begin at 6:30 p.m. unless otherwise noted by the agenda.

**The Instructional Committee and Operations Committee will be held via Google Meet.  The time of the meetings and links to the meetings will be posted by agenda.  Agendas can be found here: 

Meetings & Agendas

The meetings can be viewed on the Wallingford PS YouTube Channel.  Please see the link below.  

https://www.youtube.com/wpsconnections/live
